clauses.1.1: The annual premium is USD 720 per insured student for a twelve-month coverage period.
clauses.2.3: The insurer pays 80% of eligible outpatient expenses after application of the annual deductible, where applicable. The insured person is responsible for the remaining 20%.
clauses.2.4: The maximum amount payable for outpatient benefits is USD 2,000 per policy year.
clauses.2.5: Emergency dental treatment is covered up to USD 500 per policy year when required for sudden pain, accidental dental injury, or another urgent dental condition.
clauses.3.1: The insured person is responsible for the first USD 300 of eligible expenses subject to the annual deductible during each policy year.
clauses.3.2: The maximum aggregate benefit payable under this policy is USD 50,000 per insured person per policy year.
clauses.3.3: Emergency dental benefits are subject to a waiting period of 90 calendar days beginning on the effective date. A dental event occurring before completion of the waiting period is not eligible.
clauses.3.4: The insurer determines coverage, removes excluded charges and amounts above sub-limits, applies the remaining annual deductible, calculates the benefit percentage, and checks remaining limits.
clauses.5.1: A claim must be submitted within 60 calendar days after the covered medical event or relevant treatment expense, whichever is later.

golden_result.reason: The emergency dental incident occurred before completion of the 90-day waiting period.
